texts.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural] called upon the power of our patron, and it responded with a bounty. The End of the Cycle has materialized a Gaia World in our [capital_scope.solar_system.GetName] system, providing an ideal habitat for [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind; a fleeting paradise with which to embrace the end of all things.
